blurb: Guests join expert USCG licensed captains on fast, comfortable sportfishermen boats to fish for trophy King Salmon, Coho Salmon, Lake Trout, Brown Trout, and Steelhead. Trips target peak seasons for maximum action and are suitable for families, friends, and corporate groups up to 6 guests per boat. The captains adapt daily to find the most active fish regardless of the calendar.
